PERIOD OF INSURANCE AND WAITING PERIODS

Period of Insurance: From 00:00 hrs of 01/04/2026 To Midnight of 31/03/2027

=== PAGE BREAK ===
TIME-RELATED CONDITIONS

4.1 Grace Period. A renewal premium received within 30 days after the expiry date maintains continuity of benefits without a break in the policy. Coverage is not available during the grace period.

4.2 Free Look Period. The Insured Person shall be allowed a free look period of 15 days from the date of receipt of the policy document to review the terms and conditions.

4.3 Initial Waiting Period. Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident.

4.4 Pre-Existing Diseases. Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.

4.5 Specified Diseases. Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed conditions shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage: cataract; hernia of all types; kidney stones; gall bladder stones.

4.6 Counting of waiting periods. The waiting periods above are counted from the Date of First Inception of the Policy with the Company, subject to continuous renewal without break.

4.7 Moratorium. After completion of 60 continuous months of coverage, no policy and claim shall be contestable by the insurer on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except on grounds of established fraud.
